theorem_clauses.label: T1 shifted disintegration
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: The rooted common-stem variables define the retained quotient and admit a controlled conditional K/H split on each finite-ratio shell.
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: C5AY gives rank-17 tangent quotient with exact reflection pairing; C5AZ gives rooted gauge covariance and finite-block reflection covariance.
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: The C5AY/C5AZ repair would remain a finite-block coordinate trick, not a shell theorem.

theorem_clauses.label: T2 no unretained O(g) or O(g^2) survivors
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: All O(g_j M_j^3), O(g_j^2 M_j^2), and O(g_j^2 M_j^4) terms are either retained, renormalized, or placed in a comparison potential.
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: C5AG/C5AH bookkeeping identifies exactly which terms are forbidden as residuals.
theorem_clauses.status: contractual requirement, not yet proven in shifted nonlinear chart
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: A nonsummable shell series survives, so the route fails in its current form.

theorem_clauses.label: T3 centered odd density channel
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: The odd K/H density contribution has zero conditional mean and its first surviving effect satisfies a rooted covariance bound at O(g_j^4 M_j^4).
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: Corrected C5AZ rooted covariance scale C_cov^2=0.214804676794; C5AV-C5AW supplied the deterministic identity template.
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: A hidden O(g_j^2 M_j^2) density drift remains; C5AP/C5AQ/C5BA collapse.

theorem_clauses.label: T4 quasilocal conditional density
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: The conditional density/Jacobian constants are stable under microscopic integration and depend quasilocally on the shell boundary.
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: Only finite-block and formal shifted-coordinate evidence so far.
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: The finite-block calculation cannot be promoted to constructive continuum control.

theorem_clauses.label: T5 exceptional sector
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: Large-field, chart-boundary, and near-Cartan exceptional events have summable probability or are absorbed by retained variables/comparison potentials.
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: Near-Cartan visibility has been diagnosed as physically necessary, not solved.
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: The route may miss the coherent abelian/Cartan valleys that motivated the project.

theorem_clauses.label: T6 RP/reflection placement
theorem_clauses.statement_needed: The retained coordinate, density, and comparison-potential package is compatible with reflection positivity at the one-shell level.
theorem_clauses.current_evidence: C5AY/C5AZ removed the based-log reflection-covariance obstruction at finite block.
theorem_clauses.failure_meaning: Even correct local estimates may not imply a physical Hilbert-space mass gap.

residual_budgets.interpretation: Quartic local effects must be retained or absorbed in Phi4, not treated as error.

residual_budgets.interpretation: Summable only after exact conditional mean-zero cancellation is proven.

residual_budgets.name: allowed post-retention cubic-gain remainder

residual_budgets.name: allowed post-retention quartic-gain remainder
residual_budgets.interpretation: Summable in principle, but log powers make constants nontrivial.

decision.next_checkpoint: C5BB: prove or falsify the shifted good-sector one-shell expansion, especially T1-T3: disintegration, no O(g)/O(g^2) survivors, and centered odd density covariance.
decision.reason: C5BA passes as a contract checkpoint because the finite-block shifted coordinate package removes the reflection-coordinate obstruction and the normalized budgets still separate forbidden from summable terms. It is not a theorem checkpoint: T1-T6 remain proof obligations.
